meta.title: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2) tracker data
meta.note: N64-verified (Stage 0). switch2 flags are set in the post-launch pass. Master Quest excluded.

entries.name: Skull Kid on the stump
entries.howTo: Take the first left in the Lost Woods. Stand on the stump across from the Skull Kid and play Saria's Song.

entries.name: Skull Kids' memory game
entries.howTo: Take the first right in the Lost Woods and drop down to the stump. Two Skull Kids play a tune on their flutes; repeat it back correctly three times in a row (each round adds a note).

entries.name: Deku Scrub in the fenced grotto
entries.howTo: In the fenced-in square by the Lake Hylia entrance (southwest Hyrule Field), set a Bomb in the middle to open a grotto. Buy the Piece of Heart from the Business Scrub inside for 10 Rupees.

entries.name: Underwater grotto by the lone tree
entries.howTo: Bomb the ground beside the lone tree northwest of Lon Lon Ranch to open a grotto with a deep pool. Dive to the bottom with the Golden Scale, or sink with the Iron Boots.

entries.name: Treasure Chest Game
entries.howTo: At night, play the Treasure Chest Game in the Market. Use the Lens of Truth to see which chest holds each room's key; the chest in the last room holds the Piece of Heart.

entries.name: Bombchu Bowling prize
entries.howTo: Win at Bombchu Bowling in the Market. The prize on offer rotates, so keep playing until the Piece of Heart comes up.

entries.name: Lost dog (Richard)
entries.howTo: At night, find the white dog wandering the Market square. It follows you once you touch it; lead it to the woman's house in the Back Alley.

entries.name: Lon Lon Ranch silo
entries.howTo: In the silo at the far end of the ranch, push and pull the crates to uncover a small hole in the corner and crawl through it.

entries.name: Impa's house, by the cow
entries.howTo: Get onto the roof above the Cucco pen (the owl at the top of Death Mountain drops young Link there; adult Link can Hookshot up) and drop through the opening into the house. The Piece of Heart is next to the cow.

entries.name: Man on the roof
entries.howTo: Stand on the fence outside the Windmill and Hookshot onto the roof of the house in the center of the village, then talk to the man sitting there. (GameWith notes young Link can also reach him by side-jumping off the watchtower.)

entries.name: House of Skulltula: 50 tokens
entries.howTo: Turn in 50 Gold Skulltula tokens at the House of Skulltula.

entries.name: Dampé's Gravedigging Tour
entries.howTo: At night, talk to Dampé in the Graveyard and pay for his Gravedigging Tour. The Piece of Heart turns up in a random spot, so keep having him dig.

entries.name: Dampé's race
entries.howTo: Drop into Dampé's grave and race his ghost through the tunnel. Finish in under 1:00 to win the Piece of Heart; the route is always the same.

entries.name: Inside the Windmill
entries.howTo: It sits on a ledge inside the Windmill. Young Link: climb onto a block by the spinning platform and grab it with the Boomerang. Adult Link: it's on the way out of Dampé's grave after the race (the exit needs the Song of Time).

entries.name: Crate on the high ledge
entries.howTo: Plant a Magic Bean in the Graveyard's soft soil as young Link. As adult, ride the plant up to the high ledge on the north side (or use the Longshot) and roll into the crate.

entries.name: Sun's Song in the grave
entries.howTo: Pull back the movable gravestone (Jegged: second from the left, just below the Royal Family's Tomb; young Link can only do this at night) and drop in. Freeze or defeat the ReDead, then play the Sun's Song where it stood to make a chest appear.

entries.name: On top of Dodongo's Cavern
entries.howTo: The Piece of Heart sits on top of the Dodongo's Cavern entrance. Drop (backflip) onto it from the Bomb Flower ledge above, or as adult ride the Magic Bean plant from the soil by the entrance.

entries.name: Volcano peak (bean plant)
entries.howTo: As young Link, warp to the crater with the Bolero of Fire and plant a Magic Bean in the soil beside the warp point. As adult (wearing the Goron Tunic), ride the plant up to the peak.

entries.name: Crater wall alcove
entries.howTo: Enter the crater from the top of Death Mountain (left of the owl). Walk off the north ledge so Link grabs the wall, and climb down to a small alcove with the Piece of Heart. Young Link can't stay in the heat long.

entries.name: Spinning pot
entries.howTo: Light all four torches on Goron City's bottom floor (carry fire on a Deku Stick from the lit torches in Darunia's chamber, or use Din's Fire) so the big urn starts spinning. Throw a Bomb into it; the Piece of Heart drops when it lands on the right face. A Bomb Flower works too, but it's harder.

entries.name: Frogs: Song of Storms
entries.howTo: Stand at the end of the log sticking out into the river; frogs pop up when you take out the Ocarina. Play the Song of Storms.

entries.name: Frogs' bug-catching game
entries.howTo: Once you've played the frogs the Song of Storms plus Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, the Sun's Song and the Song of Time, they offer a game: play the note of each frog that has a bug above it. The first time, the order is fixed (N64 buttons): A, C-left, C-right, C-down, C-left, C-right, C-down, A, C-down, A, C-down, C-right, C-left, A.

entries.name: Pillar near the open grotto
entries.howTo: Carry a Cucco up Zora's River to the cliff top above the tall pillar, then glide down to the Piece of Heart on top of the pillar. GameWith notes the Boomerang can grab it too.
entries.ootrLocation: ZR Near Open Grotto Freestanding PoH

entries.name: Ledge by the waterfall
entries.howTo: Carry a Cucco all the way to the end of the river by the waterfall and glide across to the ledge holding the Piece of Heart. GameWith notes the Boomerang can grab it too.

entries.name: Zora's Domain torches
entries.howTo: Light every unlit torch in Zora's Domain with a burning Deku Stick before any of them burn out; two are behind the waterfall. A chest with the Piece of Heart appears behind the waterfall.

entries.name: Bottom of Zora's Fountain
entries.howTo: Wearing the Zora Tunic, equip the Iron Boots in Zora's Fountain to sink to the bottom, then walk to the middle.

entries.name: Iceberg in Zora's Fountain
entries.howTo: Hop across the floating ice blocks where Lord Jabu-Jabu used to be; the Piece of Heart sits on the last one.

entries.name: Ice Cavern red ice
entries.howTo: In the room with the Compass, scoop Blue Fire into a bottle from the nearby flame and use it to melt the red ice hiding the Piece of Heart.

entries.name: Lakeside Laboratory roof
entries.howTo: Ride the Magic Bean plant (soil beside the lab) up to the Lakeside Laboratory roof and climb to the top, or summon Pierre with the Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot up to him.

entries.name: Lab diving tank
entries.howTo: With the Golden Scale, dive to the bottom of the tank inside the Lakeside Laboratory, then talk to the professor.

entries.name: Fishing Pond (young)
entries.howTo: As young Link, catch a fish weighing at least 10 lb at the Fishing Pond and show it to the owner.

entries.name: Behind the Gerudo Valley waterfall
entries.howTo: Drop into the river below the bridge and climb the ladder behind the waterfall to a small alcove with the Piece of Heart.

entries.name: Crate on the small ledge
entries.howTo: Young Link: carry a Cucco to the cliff edge and glide to the small ledge with a single crate on the far side of the valley, then roll into the crate. Adult Link: Longshot over to it.

entries.name: Chest on the fortress roof
entries.howTo: From the rooftop above the jail cell, Longshot to the treasure chest on the roof (or summon Pierre with the Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot to him). You don't need the Membership Card.

entries.name: Horseback Archery: 1,000 points
entries.howTo: With the Gerudo's Membership Card, ride Epona to the archery range behind the fortress, talk to the Gerudo there and score 1,000+ points.

entries.name: Arch by the Spirit Temple
entries.howTo: As young Link (Requiem of Spirit), plant a Magic Bean in the soil in front of the Spirit Temple. As adult, ride the plant and jump onto the stone arch when it passes over.

entries.name: Know-It-All Brothers' house
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the back wall of the Know-It-All Brothers' house. Shoot it down (Slingshot) or reach it with a jump attack.
entries.ootrLocation: KF GS Know It All House

entries.name: Soft soil by the Kokiri Shop
entries.howTo: Release bugs from a bottle onto the soft soil behind the Kokiri Shop.

entries.name: House of Twins roof
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the roof of the twins' house (two stumps on top) in the southwest of the village. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Soft soil (left, left)
entries.howTo: Turn left at the Lost Woods entrance, then left again. Release bugs onto the soft soil there.
entries.ootrLocation: LW GS Bean Patch Near Bridge

entries.name: Soft soil by the Business Scrubs
entries.howTo: In the Lost Woods clearing with the Business Scrubs (on the way to the Sacred Forest Meadow), release bugs onto the soft soil.
entries.ootrLocation: LW GS Bean Patch Near Theater

entries.name: High ledge (bean plant)
entries.howTo: Plant a Magic Bean in the soil by the Business Scrubs as young Link. As adult, get past Mido (Saria's Song), and at night ride the plant to the upper ledge.

entries.name: Sacred Forest Meadow wall
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the east wall of the meadow's maze. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Grotto under the tree near Kakariko
entries.howTo: Bomb the base of the lone tree between Hyrule Castle and Kakariko Village to open a grotto. Get it with the Boomerang (young) or Hookshot (adult).

entries.name: Grotto in the rock circle near Gerudo Valley
entries.howTo: Just northeast of the Gerudo Valley entrance, open the grotto in the middle of the circle of rocks (young: Bomb; adult: Megaton Hammer). Burn the webs with Din's Fire (or Fire Arrows); it's on the back wall behind the cow. Grab it with the Boomerang or Hookshot.

entries.name: Lon Lon Ranch tree
entries.howTo: Roll into the tree near the ranch houses, on the way into the horse-pen area.

entries.name: Horse pen shelter
entries.howTo: At night, check the back of the horse pen: it's on the sheltered part of the fence.

entries.name: Ranch house window
entries.howTo: At night, it hangs by a lit window high on the ranch house. Get it with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Wall by the silo
entries.howTo: At night, it's high on the wall to the right of the silo. Get it with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Guard house crate
entries.howTo: In the guard house by the Market drawbridge (the room full of pots), roll into the crate by the soldier.

entries.name: Hyrule Castle tree
entries.howTo: Roll into the lone tree on the road up to the castle (where the owl perches).

entries.name: Song of Storms grotto by the moat
entries.howTo: Play the Song of Storms by the lone tree near the castle moat to open a grotto. Inside, bomb the walls; one hides the Gold Skulltula. Get it with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Ruined castle gate
entries.howTo: Where Hyrule Castle used to be, it's on the far side of the ruined archway/gate.

entries.name: Kakariko tree
entries.howTo: At night, roll into the tree near the village entrance.

entries.name: House of Skulltula wall
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the side wall of the House of Skulltula.

entries.name: House under construction
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the bricks of the house under construction. Don't get too close before you hit it.

entries.name: House by the Death Mountain gate
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the side of the house near the gate to Death Mountain Trail.

entries.name: Watchtower ladder
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the ladder of the watchtower. Shoot it down with the Slingshot, then climb up for the token.

entries.name: Roof of Impa's house
entries.howTo: At night, Hookshot onto the House of Skulltula roof, then Hookshot south onto the roof of Impa's house, where it waits.

entries.name: Graveyard wall
entries.howTo: At night, it's on top of the stone wall on the right as you enter the Graveyard. Get it with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Graveyard soft soil
entries.howTo: Release bugs onto the soft soil on the left side of the Graveyard.

entries.name: Soft soil at Dodongo's Cavern
entries.howTo: Once the boulder blocking Dodongo's Cavern is blown up, release bugs onto the soft soil by the entrance.

entries.name: Behind the bombable trail wall
entries.howTo: Low on the trail, blow open the cracked wall on the right. The Gold Skulltula is on the wall behind it; the wall is climbable to reach the token.

entries.name: Red rock above Dodongo's Cavern
entries.howTo: At night, smash the red boulder where the Bomb Flower used to be (above Dodongo's Cavern) with the Megaton Hammer.

entries.name: Red rock on the falling-rocks path
entries.howTo: At night, on the upper trail where rocks rain down, smash the red boulder furthest up the trail with the Megaton Hammer.

entries.name: Boulder maze crate
entries.howTo: Bomb through the rock wall on Goron City's top floor and work through the boulder maze with more Bombs. Roll into the crate at the far end.

entries.name: Center platform
entries.howTo: It's on the back of the big platform in the middle of the city. Walk out on the ropes for a clear shot and Hookshot it.

entries.name: Crater entrance crate
entries.howTo: Enter the crater from the summit and roll into the crate near the entrance right away.

entries.name: Crater soft soil
entries.howTo: Warp in with the Bolero of Fire and release bugs onto the soft soil next to the warp point.

entries.name: Zora's River entrance tree
entries.howTo: Roll into the tree at the entrance to Zora's River, left of the blocked path.

entries.name: Ladder near the waterfall
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the ladder by the waterfall near the Zora's Domain entrance. Shoot it down, then climb for the token.

entries.name: Wall by the raised grottos
entries.howTo: At night, about a third of the way up the river, it's high on the wall by the raised ledge with two caves. Hookshot it from the ledge.

entries.name: Wall above the bridge
entries.howTo: At night, it's high on the wall near the wooden bridge on the upper river. Stand on the fence/guardrail to get in Hookshot range.

entries.name: Frozen waterfall
entries.howTo: At night, go to the top of the pool where the diving game used to be and look around the left corner. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Zora's Fountain tree
entries.howTo: Roll into the tree on the small island in the southeast corner of the fountain.

entries.name: Rock wall across from the log
entries.howTo: At night, climb onto the big log sticking out of the water and look at the rock wall across from it. Get it with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Hidden cave
entries.howTo: At night, on the southeast island lift the grey boulder with the Silver Gauntlets, bomb open the hole beneath, and drop in. Follow the passage up the ladder and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

entries.name: Pillar on the small island
entries.howTo: At night, swim out to the small island with the stone pillars; it's on one of the pillars.

entries.name: Soft soil by the lab
entries.howTo: Release bugs onto the soft soil beside the Lakeside Laboratory.

entries.name: Lakeside Laboratory wall
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the outside wall of the Lakeside Laboratory. Get it with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Top of the island tree
entries.howTo: At night, Longshot up into the tree on the island with the warp point.

entries.name: Crate at the bottom of the lab tank
entries.howTo: Inside the Lakeside Laboratory, sink to the bottom of the tank with the Iron Boots, roll into the crate, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

entries.name: Soft soil on the lower ledge
entries.howTo: Grab a Cucco, glide down to the low ledge by the river (with the cow), and release bugs onto the soft soil.

entries.name: Wall by the small bridge
entries.howTo: At night, it's on the wall by the plank leading up to the big bridge (near the waterfall). Get it with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Cliff behind the carpenters' tent
entries.howTo: Cross the broken bridge (Epona's jump or the Longshot). At night, it's on the cliff behind the carpenters' tent. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Rock pillar
entries.howTo: Cross the broken bridge (Epona's jump or the Longshot). At night, it's on the arch-shaped rock pillar. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Archery range target
entries.howTo: With the Membership Card, go to the Horseback Archery range at night; it's on the farthest target. The Hookshot reaches; the Longshot makes it easier.

entries.name: Fortress top floor
entries.howTo: At night, from the rooftops above the jail cell, it's on a wall on the south side of the top floor. Longshot it.

entries.name: Haunted Wasteland structure
entries.howTo: Follow the flags to the stone structure partway across the Wasteland and drop down the hole inside. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Soft soil by the Spirit Temple
entries.howTo: Warp in with the Requiem of Spirit and release bugs onto the soft soil in front of the Spirit Temple.

entries.name: Palm tree by the dry oasis
entries.howTo: At night, it's in a palm tree by the dry oasis pit. Hookshot reaches; the Longshot makes it easier.

entries.name: Rock hill (bean plant)
entries.howTo: Plant a Magic Bean in front of the Spirit Temple as young Link. At night as adult, ride the plant and hop off on top of the rock it passes (or Longshot up).

entries.name: Compass room alcove
entries.howTo: In the 2nd-floor Compass room, raise the platforms with the switch and cross to the alcove in the south wall.

entries.name: Basement bars
entries.howTo: In the basement water room, it's on the bars across the room. Shoot it, then take a running jump from the platform to grab the token.

entries.name: Basement vine wall
entries.howTo: Right after you drop through the web into the basement, it's on the vine wall. Shoot it with the Slingshot and climb up for the token.

entries.name: Basement back room
entries.howTo: In the basement room where Gohma Larvae drop (upper left on the map), bomb the cracked wall in the northwest corner. Get the Gold Skulltula on the south wall with the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Deku Tree GS Basement Back Room

entries.name: Side room behind the cracked wall
entries.howTo: In the jagged corridor with Baby Dodongos (east of the main room), blow open the cracked wall (a Baby Dodongo's explosion works). It's in the room behind, with Keese.
entries.ootrLocation: Dodongos Cavern GS Side Room Near Lower Lizalfos

entries.name: Vines in the staircase room
entries.howTo: In the room with the big staircase (lowered by blowing up the Bomb Flowers), climb up; it's on the vines opposite the upper door.
entries.ootrLocation: Dodongos Cavern GS Vines Above Stairs

entries.name: Armos room inside the skull
entries.howTo: After entering the giant Dodongo skull, go right/east and bomb the wall at the north end. The Gold Skulltula is in the Armos room behind it.

entries.name: Staircase room, from above
entries.howTo: Come back to the staircase room from the 2nd floor (the stairs stay up now). Go around the left side and reach it with the Boomerang (or Hookshot as adult).
entries.ootrLocation: Dodongos Cavern GS Alcove Above Stairs

entries.name: Scarecrow ledge
entries.howTo: In the Baby Dodongo corridor (east side), play the Scarecrow's Song where Navi turns green to summon Pierre, Hookshot up to the ledge and take the Gold Skulltula. The Longshot also reaches.

entries.name: Vines in the water-switch room
entries.howTo: In the room with the water ditch and the switch in the middle, it's on the vines. Step on the switch to raise the water, then climb up.
entries.ootrLocation: Jabu Jabus Belly GS Water Switch Room

entries.name: Below the lobby (1 of 2)
entries.howTo: After destroying the tentacle that blocks a hole in the first room with holes, drop through that hole. Two Gold Skulltulas are below; this is one. Use the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Jabu Jabus Belly GS Lobby Basement Lower

entries.name: Below the lobby (2 of 2)
entries.howTo: Same room as the previous one (drop through the hole the tentacle was blocking); this is the second Gold Skulltula. Use the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Jabu Jabus Belly GS Lobby Basement Upper

entries.name: Vine wall before the boss
entries.howTo: In the last room before the boss (where you hit a ceiling switch with the Boomerang), it's on the far vine wall.
entries.ootrLocation: Jabu Jabus Belly GS Near Boss

entries.name: Vines in the first room
entries.howTo: Right at the start of the temple, it's on the vines on the right-side stone wall. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Main hall (four torches)
entries.howTo: In the main room with the four colored torches, it's high on the wall directly north of the entrance door. Hookshot it.

entries.name: Courtyard island (northeast)
entries.howTo: In the northeast courtyard (with the big Deku Babas), Hookshot to the back of the chest on the island, then Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the far wall.
entries.ootrLocation: Forest Temple GS Raised Island Courtyard

entries.name: Courtyard upper wall (northwest)
entries.howTo: In the northwest courtyard, stand on the upper ledge/archway and Hookshot it on the far wall (or Longshot it from below).
entries.ootrLocation: Forest Temple GS Level Island Courtyard

entries.name: Basement rotating walls
entries.howTo: Down the elevator in the main room, push the walls to rotate the basement and check the alcoves; one holds the Gold Skulltula.

entries.name: Song of Time room
entries.howTo: Climb the stairs and take the right door. Play the Song of Time to move the blue block, climb into the next room, and find it on the wall.
entries.ootrLocation: Fire Temple GS Song of Time Room

entries.name: Boulder maze hidden wall
entries.howTo: In the room with rolling boulders, head to the north side and bomb the wall where you hear the Skulltula.

entries.name: Chain-link fence (scarecrow route)
entries.howTo: On the upper level of the boulder room, play the Scarecrow's Song, Hookshot to Pierre and then to the rising platform. Go through the door; it's at the top of the chain-link fence.

entries.name: Past the hammer statue
entries.howTo: In the entrance room, smash the statue blocking the east door with the Megaton Hammer and go on through. It's in the rooms beyond (behind a Like Like).
entries.ootrLocation: Fire Temple GS Boss Key Loop

entries.name: Big round room (scarecrow route)
entries.howTo: Continue up past the chain-link fence Gold Skulltula into the huge round room; it's just to the left on the wall.

entries.name: Heart Piece / Compass room
entries.howTo: In the room with the Compass and Piece of Heart (behind red ice), it's on the back of a nearby pillar. Hookshot it.
entries.ootrLocation: Ice Cavern GS Heart Piece Room

entries.name: Spinning-blade room
entries.howTo: In the room with the spinning ice blade, it's above the Silver Rupee behind the icicles. Hookshot it.
entries.ootrLocation: Ice Cavern GS Spinning Scythe Room

entries.name: Push-block room
entries.howTo: In the room where you push the ice block (full of Ice Keese), it's on the east wall. Hookshot it.
entries.ootrLocation: Ice Cavern GS Push Block Room

entries.name: Behind the gate (crystal switch)
entries.howTo: Lower the water, then bomb the crack at the end of the south corridor on the bottom floor and swim through. In the room beyond, hit the crystal switch behind the bars (e.g. a spin attack) and take the Gold Skulltula on the other side.

entries.name: Whirlpool river
entries.howTo: Past Dark Link, play the Song of Time to move the block and drop into the whirlpool river. Use the Iron Boots by the second whirlpool and Longshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

entries.name: Inside the central pillar
entries.howTo: Inside the central pillar, from the upper level, Longshot it on the south wall.

entries.name: Moving-platform waterfall room
entries.howTo: In the west room with platforms rising over a big waterfall, Longshot it on the far right wall.
entries.ootrLocation: Water Temple GS Falling Platform Room

entries.name: Rolling-boulder channel
entries.howTo: On the way to the Boss Key, in the channel where boulders roll, wait for a boulder to pass, sink with the Iron Boots, face west and Longshot it on the wall.
entries.ootrLocation: Water Temple GS Near Boss Key Chest

entries.name: Like Like room
entries.howTo: From the main room, go to the northeast and through the locked door into the room with the Like Like. Get it with the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Bottom of the Well GS Like Like Cage

entries.name: West center room
entries.howTo: Unlock the west (left) of the two center rooms; it's on the back wall. Get it with the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Bottom of the Well GS West Inner Room

entries.name: Pit room (use the Lens)
entries.howTo: In the room with the pit, use the Lens of Truth to see the safe path around the rim, then get it with the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Bottom of the Well GS East Inner Room

entries.name: Invisible scythe room
entries.howTo: In the round room with invisible spinning scythes (use the Lens), defeat the enemies; the Gold Skulltula is on the wall. Hookshot/Longshot the token.
entries.ootrLocation: Shadow Temple GS Invisible Blades Room

entries.name: Falling-spikes room
entries.howTo: In the room where spiked panels drop, use the Lens to find the hidden red block, push it under the spikes, and find the Gold Skulltula in the cell on the north side.
entries.ootrLocation: Shadow Temple GS Falling Spikes Room

entries.name: Behind the giant skull pot
entries.howTo: In the room with the big blue-flamed skull, it's hiding behind the skull. Attack it with your sword.
entries.ootrLocation: Shadow Temple GS Single Giant Pot

entries.name: Boat room ledge
entries.howTo: In the room with the big boat, climb the ladder, turn around, play the Scarecrow's Song and Longshot to Pierre; the Gold Skulltula is nearby.

entries.name: Three spinning skulls
entries.howTo: After the boat ride, in the room with three spinning blue-flamed skulls, it's behind one of them (destroy them).
entries.ootrLocation: Shadow Temple GS Triple Giant Pot

entries.name: Chain-link fence (young)
entries.howTo: In the young-Link room with the chain-link fence and Silver Rupees, kill the Gold Skulltula on the fence first; get the token with the Boomerang.

entries.name: Climbing room (young)
entries.howTo: In the room with the climbable wall (two Skulltulas on it), it's on the opposite wall. Use the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Spirit Temple GS Sun on Floor Room

entries.name: Above the Iron Knuckle door (young)
entries.howTo: After the sun-block puzzle, walk partway up the stairwell and turn around: it's just above the doorway to the Iron Knuckle room. Use the Boomerang.
entries.ootrLocation: Spirit Temple GS Hall After Sun Block Room

entries.name: Rolling-boulder room (adult)
entries.howTo: In the room with boulders rolling in a trench, play the Song of Time in front of the blue block to uncover it.

entries.name: Big statue room (adult)
entries.howTo: In the big statue room, climb the stairs on the west side, play the Scarecrow's Song, and Longshot to Pierre to reach it.

entries.name: Keaton Mask
entries.howTo: After you show Zelda's Letter to the guard at the Death Mountain gate, borrow the Keaton Mask from the Happy Mask Shop. Wear it and talk to that guard; he buys it for 15 Rupees. Pay the shop back 10.

entries.name: Skull Mask
entries.howTo: Borrow the Skull Mask (20 Rupees). Wear it to the Skull Kid by the stump at the first left in the Lost Woods (play Saria's Song for him first if you haven't). He only pays 10, so you'll need 10 more to pay the shop back.

entries.name: Spooky Mask
entries.howTo: Borrow the Spooky Mask (30 Rupees). Wear it and talk to the kid in the Graveyard during the day; he pays 30.

entries.name: Bunny Hood
entries.howTo: Borrow the Bunny Hood (50 Rupees). Once you have all three Spiritual Stones, find the running man in Hyrule Field (around Lon Lon Ranch) and talk to him wearing it; he fills your wallet. Pay the shop back 50.

entries.name: Mask of Truth
entries.howTo: After paying for the Bunny Hood, the Happy Mask Shop gives you the Mask of Truth (lets you read Gossip Stones) and lets you borrow the Goron, Zora and Gerudo Masks.

entries.name: Bomb Bag upgrade: rolling Goron
entries.howTo: In Goron City, stop the Goron rolling around the upper floor by timing a Bomb so it explodes as he passes.

entries.name: Bomb Bag upgrade: Bombchu Bowling
entries.howTo: Play Bombchu Bowling in the Market until the Bomb Bag comes up as the prize, then win it.

entries.name: Deku Nut upgrade: grotto scrub
entries.howTo: Bomb the boulder by the path to the Sacred Forest Meadow (past Mido's spot in the Lost Woods) and drop into the grotto. Buy the bigger Deku Nut bag from the Business Scrub for 40 Rupees.

entries.name: Deku Nut upgrade: Forest Stage (Mask of Truth)
entries.howTo: In the Lost Woods go right, left, right, left, left, then drop into the hidden hole near the butterflies. Wear the Mask of Truth on the Forest Stage.

entries.name: Bullet Bag upgrade: Lost Woods target
entries.howTo: Take the first right in the Lost Woods and hit the target's bullseye with the Slingshot three times in a row.

entries.name: Bullet Bag upgrade: Market Shooting Gallery
entries.howTo: Get a perfect score at the Market Shooting Gallery as young Link.

entries.name: Deku Stick upgrade: Lost Woods scrub
entries.howTo: Turn left, then left again in the Lost Woods and buy the bigger Deku Stick bag from the Business Scrub for 40 Rupees.

entries.name: Deku Stick upgrade: Forest Stage (Skull Mask)
entries.howTo: In the Lost Woods go right, left, right, left, left, then drop into the hidden hole near the butterflies. Wear the Skull Mask on the Forest Stage.

entries.name: Quiver upgrade: Kakariko Shooting Gallery
entries.howTo: Get a perfect score at the Kakariko Village Shooting Gallery as adult Link.

entries.name: Quiver upgrade: Horseback Archery 1,500
entries.howTo: Score 1,500+ points at Horseback Archery (Gerudo's Membership Card, riding Epona).

entries.name: Magic Meter & Spin Attack
entries.howTo: At the top of Death Mountain Trail, bomb the wall left of the crater entrance (by the owl). Stand on the Triforce and play Zelda's Lullaby.

entries.name: Din's Fire
entries.howTo: On the way up to Hyrule Castle, climb the vines past the gate and head to the boulder on the far east side. Bomb it, crawl in, and play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce.

entries.name: Farore's Wind
entries.howTo: In Zora's Fountain, swim to the small island in the southeast corner and bomb the boulder there. Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce.

entries.name: Enhanced Magic Meter
entries.howTo: In Death Mountain Crater (Hookshot back across the broken bridge from the Bolero warp), smash the boulders blocking the cave with the Megaton Hammer. Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce.

entries.name: Nayru's Love
entries.howTo: In the Desert Colossus, bomb the cracked rock wall north of where you enter (northeast on the mini-map). Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce.

entries.name: Enhanced Defense
entries.howTo: With the Golden Gauntlets (from Ganon's Castle), lift the giant pillar/boulder at the dead end east of Ganon's Castle. Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce.

entries.name: Pocket Egg (wake Talon)
entries.howTo: As adult, talk to the Cucco lady in Kakariko (by the pen) during the day for a Pocket Egg. It hatches the next morning (Sun's Song speeds it up). Use the Pocket Cucco to wake Talon, asleep in the house in the middle of the village.

entries.name: Cojiro
entries.howTo: After waking Talon, show the Pocket Cucco to the Cucco lady. She gives you Cojiro, the blue Cucco.

entries.name: Odd Mushroom
entries.howTo: Take the first left in the Lost Woods; use Cojiro near the man slumped by the stump to wake him. He hands you the Odd Mushroom, and a timer starts.

entries.name: Odd Potion
entries.howTo: Before the timer runs out, take the Odd Mushroom to the old woman in the back room of the Kakariko Potion Shop (go in from the back). Riding Epona across Hyrule Field helps you make it.

entries.name: Poacher's Saw
entries.howTo: Go back to the same spot in the Lost Woods. The man is gone and a Kokiri girl is there; give her the Odd Potion for the Poacher's Saw.

entries.name: Broken Goron's Sword
entries.howTo: Cross the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley (Epona's jump or Longshot) and give the saw to the master carpenter by the tent.

entries.name: Prescription
entries.howTo: Take the broken sword to Biggoron at the top of Death Mountain Trail (approach the hollow right of the crater entrance).

entries.name: Eyeball Frog
entries.howTo: Show the Prescription to King Zora. He's frozen, so thaw him first with Blue Fire (from the Ice Cavern) carried in a bottle.

entries.name: World's Finest Eye Drops
entries.howTo: Within 3 minutes, take the Eyeball Frog to the professor at the Lakeside Laboratory. Ride down Zora's River and take Epona across the field; warping isn't allowed.

entries.name: Claim Check
entries.howTo: Within 4 minutes, take the eye drops back to Biggoron. A Magic Bean plant at Dodongo's Cavern makes the climb much faster.

entries.name: Biggoron's Sword
entries.howTo: Wait 3 days (play the Sun's Song 6 times), then show Biggoron the Claim Check for the sword.

entries.name: Zora's River
entries.howTo: Right next to the Magic Bean seller. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Kokiri Forest
entries.howTo: Behind the Kokiri Shop. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Lost Woods (near the bridge)
entries.howTo: Turn left, then left again at the Lost Woods entrance. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Lost Woods (Business Scrubs)
entries.howTo: In the clearing with the Business Scrubs, on the way to the Sacred Forest Meadow. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Lake Hylia
entries.howTo: Next to the Lakeside Laboratory. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Graveyard
entries.howTo: Left side of the Graveyard, below the high ledge. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Death Mountain Trail
entries.howTo: By the Dodongo's Cavern entrance, once its boulder is cleared. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Death Mountain Crater
entries.howTo: Next to the warp point; warp in with the Bolero of Fire. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Gerudo Valley
entries.howTo: On the low riverside ledge (with the cow); glide down with a Cucco. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Desert Colossus
entries.howTo: In front of the Spirit Temple entrance; warp in with the Requiem of Spirit. Plant a Magic Bean as young Link (beans come from the seller in Zora's River, 10 Rupees more each time). As adult, ride the plant.

entries.name: Big Poe #1
entries.howTo: Ride south away from the castle past the sign in front of Hyrule Castle. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #2
entries.howTo: Ride between the tree and the ranch wall at Lon Lon Ranch's north entrance. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #3
entries.howTo: Under the fenced cliff in northeast Hyrule Field, by the river near the Kakariko Village entrance. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #4
entries.howTo: Near the fork in the path between Kakariko Village and Lon Lon Ranch; ride up to the large boulder there. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #5
entries.howTo: Ride close alongside the stone wall east of Lon Lon Ranch. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #6
entries.howTo: South of that fork, ride through the patch of shrubs by the lone tree. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #7
entries.howTo: Farther south among the trees, close to the large rock. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #8
entries.howTo: At the fork in the road in southwest Hyrule Field (the north–south trail by the Gerudo Valley entrance). Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #9
entries.howTo: Ride past the lone tree on the western edge of the field, near the Gerudo Valley entrance. Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Big Poe #10
entries.howTo: In the tall grass by the water's edge in northwest Hyrule Field (the river west of the castle). Big Poes only appear while you're riding Epona: hit it with two arrows, then catch it in an empty bottle and sell it at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance).

entries.name: Talon's Cucco game
entries.howTo: After Talon is back at the ranch (you wake him at Hyrule Castle), talk to him in the house during the day and find his three Super Cuccos among the regular ones. The prize is a bottle of Lon Lon Milk.

entries.name: Cucco lady's lost Cuccos
entries.howTo: In Kakariko Village during the day, gather the Cucco lady's seven loose Cuccos (one is in a crate) and throw them back into her pen.

entries.name: Ruto's Letter
entries.howTo: With the Silver Scale (from the Zora diving game), dive at Lake Hylia for the bottled letter from Princess Ruto. Show it to King Zora and you keep the bottle.

entries.name: Ghost Shop: 10 Big Poes
entries.howTo: Sell Big Poes at the Ghost Shop (the guard house by the Market entrance): 100 points each. At 1,000 points, the shopkeeper gives you an empty bottle.

entries.name: Fifth bottle (Switch 2 remake)
entries.howTo: 🚧 New in the Switch 2 remake: a Nintendo rep confirmed to IGN that the fifth inventory slot is an extra bottle. How you get it is unknown until launch.

skulltulaRewards.switch2Note: Kotaku/IGN: the remake's starting wallet already holds 200 Rupees, so this reward is something new (not yet known).
